description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified vSwitch
description_zh: 调用ModifyVSwitchAttribute接口修改指定交换机的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-vswitch-attribute --vswitch-id vsw-25nacdfvue40000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVSwitchAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the vSwitch.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
交换机要修改的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: vswitch_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the vSwitch. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 交换机所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the vSwitch.  

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
交换机要修改的描述信息。  

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The last 8 bits of the IPv6 CIDR block of the vSwitch. Valid values: 0 to 255.

You can specify this parameter only when the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs has IPv6 enabled. This parameter is used to assign an IPv6 CIDR block to the vSwitch. After the IPv6 CIDR block is allocated, it cannot be changed to another CIDR block. Make sure that the CIDR block does not overlap with those of other vSwitches in the same VPC
parameters.help_zh:
交换机IPv6网段的最后8比特位，取值：0~255。

仅交换机所属VPC已开启IPv6时，您可以传入此参数为交换机分配IPv6网段。IPv6网段分配后，无法修改为其他网段。需确保与所属VPC下其他交换机的网段不重叠
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable IPv6 for the vSwitch. Valid values:

true: enables IPv6. The VPC to which the vSwitch belongs must have IPv6 enabled. You must also specify Ipv6CidrBlock to assign an IPv6 CIDR block to the vSwitch.
false (default): disables IPv6. When you disable IPv6 for the vSwitch, make sure that no IPv6 addresses are in use. You cannot specify Ipv6CidrBlock at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
交换机是否开启IPv6。取值：

true：开启IPv6。需所属VPC已开启IPv6，并同时传入Ipv6CidrBlock为交换机分配IPv6网段。
false（默认值）：关闭。为交换机关闭IPv6时，需确保IPv6地址未被使用，且不可同时传入Ipv6CidrBlock
parameters.name: enable_ipv6

parameters.help_en:
The IPv6 CIDR block of the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs.
If the VPC has multiple IPv6 CIDR blocks, you can specify this parameter to indicate the IPv6 CIDR block range for the vSwitch. If you do not specify this parameter, the IPv6 CIDR block assigned when IPv6 was enabled for the VPC is used
parameters.help_zh:
交换机所在VPC的IPv6网段。
当交换机所属VPC具有多个IPv6网段时，您可以传入此参数指定交换机所属的IPv6网段范围。如不指定，将选择VPC开启IPv6时分配的 IPv6 网段
parameters.name: vpc_ipv6_cidr_block
